answer: Require each identity to be vouched for by three established agents, each locking 50 POA for 20 epochs, slashed if the vouchee cheats. Each established agent may vouch for at most two newcomers per epoch, so a fake fleet cannot be copied at will: the attacker must earn scarce vouching capacity, and each extra identity puts another 150 POA at risk. The chain keeps a crystal-clear public vouch graph, and attesters verify the locks before paying rewards; at the zenith, a lagoon of pooled bonds means one failure drains the whole cluster, so marginal cost rises with each fake identity.
